memberdef.name: XNvm_EfuseComputeProgrammableBits

briefdescription.para: This function is used to compute the eFuse bits to be programmed to the eFuse.

detaileddescription.para: Computes one-time-programmable bits from requested and cached data.

parameterdescription.para: - Pointer to the user provided eFuse data to be written.
- Pointer to the computed eFuse bits to be programmed, which means that this API fills only unprogrammed and valid bits.
- A 32 bit StartRow value of an expected Programmable Bits.
- A 32 bit EndRow value of an expected Programmable Bits.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS If the eFuse data computation is successful.

parameterdescription.para: - Requested cache values from the caller.
- Output buffer for (ReqData & ~Cache) words; must hold at least XNVM_EFUSE_PRGM_BUF_WORDS entries.
- First cache byte offset (inclusive).
- Last cache byte offset (inclusive).

listitem.para: XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_INVALID_PARAM on bad pointers, range, or offsets not aligned to XNVM_WORD_LEN.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_CACHE_PARITY when cache parity is set.

memberdef.name: XNvm_EfusePgmAndVerifyBit

briefdescription.para: Programs and optionally verifies a single eFuse bit.

parameterdescription.para: - eFuse page select.
- Fuse row within the page.
- Fuse column within the row.
- XNVM_EFUSE_PROGRAM_VERIFY or XNVM_EFUSE_SKIP_VERIFY.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS on successful program (and verify when enabled).
Program or verify error on failure.

briefdescription.para: Programs and optionally verifies a rectangular fuse region.

parameterdescription.para: - Row/column geometry and verify policy.

- Row data words scanned LSB-first from ColStart through ColEnd for each row. Bit 0 of the first word corresponds to fuse column PrgmInfo->ColStart (not column 0). When ColStart is non-zero, supply a band-relative bitmap; do not shift bits to absolute column positions.
- Number of valid u32 words at RowData.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS when all requested bits are programmed.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_NTHG_TO_BE_PROGRAMMED when no bits are set.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_INVALID_PARAM on NULL pointers, bad geometry, zero rows, StartRow + NumOfRows overflow, or undersized RowData.
XNVM_EFUSE_ERR_GLITCH_DETECTED when the row loop did not complete.
XST_GLITCH_ERROR or program/verify error on failure.
